name: ui-change-guard
description: Pre-push safety review for UX/UI changes in web and native/mobile apps (htmx/Alpine, React, React Native, SwiftUI, Compose, Flutter, Capacitor): catches removed form fields the backend depends on, redesigned pages that lost functionality, performance regressions, broken htmx/Alpine wiring, accessibility and security regressions, and weakened tests. Returns a SAFE / UNSAFE verdict with the list of issues. Optional push guard (install/uninstall) runs the review before every git push.
